subproblem.title: An integer-weighted bi-Lipschitz parametrized piece carries an integer multiplicity triple (area formula)
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P open. Let H : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |H(a) − H(a')| for a, a' ∈ B, H differentiable with injective derivative at every point of B, and H(B) ⊆ U. Write J(a) := (det(DH(a)*∘DH(a)))^{1/2} and Ae := (Ae₁, …, Aeₙ) for a linear A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P. Let w : ℝⁿ → ℕ be measurable with w ≥ 1 on B, and ζ : ℝⁿ → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) a.e. strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure on B, such that for a.e. a ∈ B there is s ∈ {1, −1} with ζ(a)(α) = s·α(DH(a)e) for every n-covector α. Assume ∫_B w(a)J(a) da < ∞. Then there is an integer multiplicity triple R in U (IMRep U n) with mass μ_R(U) = R.measure U = ∫⁻_B w(a)J(a) da and with R.action(ω) = ∫_B w(a)·ζ(a)(ω(H(a))) da for every n-form ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, no regularity required).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ) (w : Euclid n → ℕ) (ζ : Euclid n → MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → H '' B ⊆ U → Measurable w → (∀ a ∈ B, 1 ≤ w a) → AEStronglyMeasurable ζ (volume.restrict B) → (∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict B), ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ζ a α = s * α (fun j => fderiv ℝ H a (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → ∫⁻ a in B, (w a : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ H a).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ H a).det)) ∂volume ≠ ∞ → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.measure U = ∫⁻ a in B, (w a : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ H a).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ H a).det)) ∂volume ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = ∫ a in B, (w a : ℝ) * ζ a (ω (H a)) ∂volume
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent proof for a single piece (the image piece N = H(B) with multiplicity w∘(H|_B)⁻¹ and orientation ±DH_#e/J_H transported by the area formula), together with the part of step 9 that identifies the approximate tangent planes of N along the piece (here supplied by the sibling piece_tangent, applied to Y := N).
Notation: Hⁿ := μHE[n] (on ℝⁿ it equals Lebesgue measure Lⁿ = volume, EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume); N := H(B); V_a := range DH(a).
1. Injectivity and Borel image. If a, a' ∈ B and H(a) = H(a'), then m|a − a'| ≤ 0, so a = a' (m > 0). H is continuous and injective on the Borel set B, so N is Borel (Lusin–Souslin, Mathlib MeasurableSet.image_of_continuousOn_injOn) and the restriction H|_B : B → ℝ^P is a measurable embedding (ContinuousOn.measurableEmbedding).
2. The Jacobian. a ↦ DH(a) is Borel (Mathlib measurable_fderiv) and A ↦ (det(A*A))^{1/2} is continuous (adjoint, composition and det are continuous), so J is Borel. For a ∈ B, DH(a) is injective, so det(DH(a)*DH(a)) > 0 by sibling inj_orientation and J(a) > 0.
3. Area formulas. Since B is Borel, H is differentiable with injective derivative on B and injective on B, SimonGMT's area formulas (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02: weighted_area_formula_volume_of_injective_derivative and integral_area_formula_of_injective_derivative, whose Jacobian areaJacobianAt H a equals J(a) by areaJacobianAt_eq_sqrt_det_adjoint_comp; finrank ℝⁿ = n) give: (3a) ∫⁻_N g dHⁿ = ∫⁻_B J(a)g(H(a)) da for every g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]; (3b) ∫_N g dHⁿ = ∫_B J(a)g(H(a)) da for every g : ℝ^P → ℝ (no integrability or measurability hypothesis).
4. A measurable version of ζ. Let ζ' be strongly measurable with ζ' = ζ Lⁿ⌞B-a.e. (AEStronglyMeasurable.mk).
5. The triple. For y ∈ N let a_y ∈ B be the unique point with H(a_y) = y (step 1) and put mult(y) := w(a_y), orient(y) := J(a_y)⁻¹·ζ'(a_y); for y ∉ N put mult(y) := 0, orient(y) := 0. (In Lean: Function.extend along H|_B of the functions w and J⁻¹ζ' restricted to B.) mult is measurable and orient is strongly measurable, being the extensions by constants along the measurable embedding H|_B of the measurable map w|_B and the strongly measurable map (J⁻¹ζ')|_B (MeasurableEmbedding.measurable_extend, MeasurableEmbedding.stronglyMeasurable_extend). For a ∈ B: mult(H(a)) = w(a) ≥ 1 and orient(H(a)) = J(a)⁻¹ζ'(a).
6. Masses. By (3a) with g := mult and step 5, ∫⁻_N mult dHⁿ = ∫⁻_B J(a)w(a) da < ∞. By (3a) with g := 1, Hⁿ(N) = ∫⁻_B J ≤ ∫⁻_B wJ < ∞ (w ≥ 1 on B).
7. Orientation along the piece. N is Borel, N ⊆ ℝ^P (open) and Hⁿ(N ∩ C) ≤ Hⁿ(N) < ∞ for every compact C, so sibling piece_tangent applied to (U, Y) := (ℝ^P, N) and (H, B, L, m) gives: for a.e. a ∈ B, N has the approximate tangent space V_a at H(a). Fix a ∈ B in the conull set where moreover ζ(a) = ζ'(a) and ζ(a)(α) = s·α(DH(a)e) for all α with s ∈ {1, −1}. Then for every α, α(DH(a)e) = s·ζ'(a)(α) = J(a)·(s·orient(H(a)))(α) (using s² = 1 and orient(H(a)) = J(a)⁻¹ζ'(a)). By sibling inj_orientation (with F := DH(a), injective), s·orient(H(a)) is a unit orientation of V_a. If s = 1 this is the claim for orient(H(a)); if s = −1, orient(H(a)) = −(s·orient(H(a))), and the negative of a unit orientation of V_a is a unit orientation of V_a (exchange the two disjuncts in IsUnitOrientationOf). So N has an approximate tangent space at H(a) of which orient(H(a)) is a unit orientation.
8. Transfer to N. Let Z ⊆ B be the set of a ∈ B where the conclusion of step 7 fails; Lⁿ(Z) = 0. H is L-Lipschitz, so Hⁿ(H(Z)) ≤ Lⁿ·Hⁿ(Z) = Lⁿ·Lⁿ(Z) = 0 (SimonGMT euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image_le_of_lipschitzOn). Every y ∈ N ∖ H(Z) equals H(a) for some a ∈ B ∖ Z. Hence for Hⁿ⌞N-a.e. y there is Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N y Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (orient y) Q.
9. R is an IMRep in U. carrier := N is Borel (step 1) and N ⊆ U (hypothesis); N ⊆ H(ℝⁿ), the range of a Lipschitz map, so N is countably n-rectifiable (SimonGMT countablyRectifiable_range and CountablyRectifiable.mono); mult is measurable with mult ≥ 1 on N (step 5); for compact C ⊆ U, ∫⁻_{N∩C} mult dHⁿ ≤ ∫⁻_N mult dHⁿ < ∞ (step 6); orient is strongly measurable, hence a.e. strongly measurable (step 5); the orientation field holds by step 8.
10. Mass. U is open, hence Borel, and N ⊆ U, so R.measure U = ∫⁻_{U∩N} mult dHⁿ = ∫⁻_N mult dHⁿ = ∫⁻_B w(a)J(a) da (withDensity_apply, step 6).
11. Action. For every n-form ω, by (3b) with g(y) := mult(y)·orient(y)(ω(y)) and step 5: R.action(ω) = ∫_N mult·orient(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_B J(a)·w(a)·J(a)⁻¹·ζ'(a)(ω(H(a))) da = ∫_B w(a)·ζ'(a)(ω(H(a))) da (J(a) > 0 on B) = ∫_B w(a)·ζ(a)(ω(H(a))) da (ζ' = ζ a.e. on B). ∎

proof_key_steps: H is injective on B, N = H(B) is Borel and H|_B is a measurable embedding (Lusin–Souslin).
J is Borel and positive on B; the SimonGMT area formulas give ∫⁻_N g dHⁿ = ∫⁻_B J·(g∘H) and ∫_N g dHⁿ = ∫_B J·(g∘H).
mult := w∘(H|_B)⁻¹ and orient := (J⁻¹ζ')∘(H|_B)⁻¹ on N (extensions along the embedding; ζ' a strongly measurable version of ζ).

Sibling piece_tangent (Y = N) and sibling inj_orientation make orient(H(a)) a unit orientation of the approximate tangent plane range DH(a) for a.e. a ∈ B; Lipschitz images of null sets are null, so this holds Hⁿ-a.e. on N.
All IMRep fields hold; R.measure U = ∫_B wJ and R.action(ω) = ∫_B w·ζ(ω∘H) by the area formula.
